اغتديت (form VIII)
# اِغْتَدَيْتُ (iḡtadaytu) /iɣ.ta.daj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِغْتَدَى (iḡtadā)
# اِغْتَدَيْتَ (iḡtadayta) /iɣ.ta.daj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِغْتَدَى (iḡtadā)
# اِغْتَدَيْتِ (iḡtadayti) /iɣ.ta.daj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِغْتَدَى (iḡtadā)
# اُغْتُدِيتُ (uḡtudītu) /uɣ.tu.diː.tu/: first-person singular
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
